name: get_current_datetime
description: Call this function whenever discussing current events, recent developments, time-sensitive information, or when converting relative times (e.g., 'tomorrow at 2 PM') for scheduling. This function returns the current date and time.

format.description: The format of the datetime information to return. 'full', 'date_only', 'time_only' or 'year_only' are your options. Default is 'full' if not specified.

name: open_path
description: Opens a specified file, folder, or application on the user's computer, or opens a URL in the default web browser. Use for launching apps, documents, folders, or websites mentioned by the user. The user runs Arch Linux with Hyprland. To open a website (for example a music streaming service such as Qobuz, Spotify or YouTube), pass the full https URL. To open a local application, pass its command name or .desktop name.

target.description: The target to open. Can be an absolute file path (e.g. '/home/helios/file.txt'), a folder path (e.g. '/home/helios/Documents'), a Linux application command (e.g. 'firefox'), or a full URL (e.g. 'https://play.qobuz.com'). The user is on Arch Linux; never use Windows paths.

name: manage_clipboard
description: Manages the system clipboard. Can read the current text content from the clipboard or write new text content to it. Useful for transferring text between Alice and other applications.

action.description: Specifies the operation to perform: 'read' to get text from the clipboard, 'write' to put text onto the clipboard.

content.description: The text content to write to the clipboard. Required only when the action is 'write'. Ignored for 'read'.

name: save_memory
description: Store a long-term memory about the User. The memory should be a short, clear description that you can recall later to better understand and assist him. For example: 'User, enjoys hiking in the mountains.' Categorize the memory by type (e.g., 'personal', 'work', 'hobby').

content.description: The memory content to store. It should be a brief but meaningful description of the fact or event.

memoryType.description: The type of memory, like 'personal', 'work', 'hobby'. Default is 'general'.

name: delete_memory
description: Forget a long-term memory about User by permanently deleting it from storage. Use this if the memory is no longer valid or User asks you to forget it.

id.description: The unique ID of the memory to delete. This ID identifies exactly which memory should be removed.

name: recall_memories
description: Retrieve long-term memories stored about the User. Use the query parameter to find memories relevant to a specific topic or context. If query is omitted, recent memories are returned.

query.description: The topic, question, or context to find relevant memories for. Omit to get recent general memories.

memoryType.description: Filter memories by type (e.g., 'personal', 'work'). Can be combined with a query.

name: list_directory
description: Lists the files and folders in a specified directory on the user's computer. Use this to explore the file system.

path.description: The absolute path of the directory to list.

name: execute_command
description: Executes a shell command on the user's computer (Arch Linux with Hyprland, bash shell). The user is prompted to approve each command before it runs. Use this to launch applications, control media playback, or query the system. Prefer open_path for simply opening a URL or app.

name: schedule_task
description: Schedules a command or a verbal reminder to run on a recurring basis. IMPORTANT: Use recurring patterns, not specific dates or times. Examples: 'every morning at 8 AM', 'every hour', 'daily at 6 PM', 'every Friday at 11 PM'.

name.description: A descriptive name for the scheduled task (e.g., 'Morning calendar check', 'Hourly stretch reminder').

schedule.description: RECURRING schedule pattern. Use phrases like: 'every morning at 8 AM', 'every hour', 'daily at 9:30 PM', 'every Monday at 2 PM', 'every weekday at 9 AM'. Avoid specific dates - use recurring patterns instead.

action_type.description: Type of action: 'command' to execute a shell command, 'reminder' for Alice to speak a message.

details.description: For 'command': the shell command to execute. For 'reminder': the message for Alice to speak.

name: manage_scheduled_tasks
description: View, delete, or toggle scheduled tasks. Use this to list all scheduled tasks, remove unwanted ones, or activate/deactivate tasks.

action.description: Action to perform: 'list' to show all tasks, 'delete' to remove a task, 'toggle' to activate/deactivate a task.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to delete or toggle. Required for 'delete' and 'toggle' actions.

name: perform_web_search
description: Searches the web for information on a given query. Use this for current events, general knowledge questions, or topics not covered by other tools. Use this tool for browsing the web and when you don't know something or need additional context or data.

query.description: The specific search query or question to look up on the web.
